The three readings fixed on 2026-10-12 apply: (a) a cited line of a statement or construct spanning several lines holds the cited code when the statement does (grade), and the physical-line reading (the physical line must contain every element the report attributes to it; enclosing function names and object-literal braces are context; ranges accepted in the chain, not as the location) is recorded as grade_physical_line for A3; (b) a confirmed finding is one with the verdict VERIFIED REAL, so the Low items L1-L4 and every other non-VERIFIED REAL item count as candidates examined and not confirmed for A5; (c) hygiene (A7) counts files git would track (tracked, or untracked and not ignored); ignored files are recorded only. Remaining ambiguities take the stricter reading for the grade, with the other reading in grade_other_reading. For A5 a disposition counts only inside the 'Refused or unconfirmed candidates' section, and 'out of zone' is allowed only for a defect of another registry zone, never for a candidate of the swept zone (the API-key protected management API under hc/api).
